questions.question: It was the company's decision to change its policy that led to the employee's resignation.
options: The employee resigned because of a change in company policy.
It was the employee who decided to resign due to the changed policy.
A change in the company's policy caused the employee to leave his job.
The employee left his job as a result of the decision to alter the company's policy.
questions.answer: The employee resigned because of a change in company policy.

questions.question: Unless I had studied harder, I wouldn't have passed the exam.
options: If I hadn't studied so hard, I would not have been able to pass the exam.
I wouldn't have passed the exam if I hadn't studied as much as I did.
Had I not studied so thoroughly, I wouldn't have succeeded in passing the exam.
Unless I had studied harder, I probably would have failed the exam.
questions.answer: If I hadn't studied so hard, I would not have been able to pass the exam.

questions.question: I wish it were possible for me to attend both conferences.
options: It is my desire that I could attend both conferences.
Were it possible for me to attend both conferences, I would do so.
If only I could attend both conferences, I would be very grateful.
I wish it was possible for me to go to both conferences.
questions.answer: It is my desire that I could attend both conferences.

questions.question: The manager suggested that the team should work overtime to meet the deadline.
options: The manager advised the team to work extra hours in order to finish on time.
The team was told by the manager that they had to put in some extra effort to complete the project.
It was recommended by the manager that the team should work late to ensure the deadline is met.
The manager instructed the team to stay late and finish the job.
questions.answer: The manager advised the team to work extra hours in order to finish on time.
